_comment: SBER rsi_zone point 2026-09-28: RSI(4) cross below 15, close > EMA(100), exit on RSI(4) cross above 75, stop 2.0 daily ATR. Chosen from the in-sample plateau of cal_joint.json over the full 36 months (the RSI(4)@15 / EMA 100 cluster, 92-93 trades, PF 1.98-2.03 at stop 3). Fixed-point replay over the same four walk-forward windows (NOT out-of-sample: the point saw these months): pooled PF 2.038, 60 trades, folds 7.530/1.847/0.672/2.508; at doubled commission 0.001: 1.441, folds 5.194/1.123/0.472/1.690. Full 36 months: PF 1.575, 93 trades, +12.3%, max DD 6.0%, 2 SL exits. Stop 3.0 looks better (PF 1.980, pooled 2.931) only because it never fires on this history (0 SL exits out of 93): that is the wide-stop trap, so 2.0 is taken as the widest stop that still acts. Defaults for comparison: PF 0.782 on 299 trades over 36 months, pooled 0.854. Caveat: the honest out-of-sample result of the grid procedure is cal_phased.json at 1.360 — below the 1.5 bar; fold 3 (2025-09..2026-03) loses on every candidate. Run: go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker SBER -strategy rsi_zone -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_zone/sber/point.json -out ./reports/SBER_zone_point -months 36 -train-months 12 -test-months 6 -min-trades 1 -metric profit_factor
